# ARC Demo Synthesis Discipline

Use when ARC demonstrations differ in geometry, orientation, palette, or apparent operation, and repeated requests risk replacing synthesis with guesswork.

## Workflow
1. After every demo, record exact input/output differences and unchanged regions.
2. Maintain a compact comparison table: dimensions/orientation, background, guide/boundary colors, marker colors, output fill colors, changed regions, and unchanged regions. Normalize examples geometrically before concluding they are unrelated.

    # Colored horizontal bands define a sequence; repeat it to replace blank bands.
    rows = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n = len(rows)
    colored = [(i, row) for i, row in enumerate(rows) if any(row)]
    if not colored:
        return rows
    # Extract the recurring band sequence by removing blank rows and repeated cycles.
    seq = [row for _, row in colored]
    p = len(seq)
    for k in range(1, len(seq) + 1):
        if all(seq[i] == seq[i % k] for i in range(len(seq))):
            p = k
            break
    motif = seq[:p]
    # Phase is fixed by first colored row: input anchors its row color at its position.
    first_i, first_row = colored[0]
    first_color = motif.index(first_row)
    return [motif[(first_color + r - first_i) % p][:] for r in range(n)]

# Optional pairs can be passed to check(transform): compares matrices exactly.
def check(pairs):
    return all(transform(inp) == out for inp, out in pairs)
